exclusions.source_text: Participant must have an Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group Performance Status 0 or 1.
Renal function is defined as Glomerular filtration rate (GFR) ≥ 50 mL/min/1.73m2.
Aspartate aminotransferase (AST) and alanine aminotransferase (ALT) ≤ 3 × upper limit of normal (ULN); ≤ 5 × ULN if liver metastases are present.
exclusions.threshold: AST/ALT ≤ 3 × ULN; ≤ 5 × ULN if liver metastases

exclusions.source_text: Total bilirubin ≤ 1.5 × ULN not associated with Gilbert's syndrome. If associated with Gilbert's syndrome ≤ 3 x ULN is acceptable.
exclusions.threshold: Total bilirubin ≤ 1.5 × ULN (≤ 3 × ULN if Gilbert's)

exclusions.source_text: Participant with known symptomatic brain metastases requiring \> 10 mg/day of prednisolone (or its equivalent).
Participants has known human immunodeficiency virus (HIV), hepatitis B, or hepatitis C infection that is considered uncontrolled based on the criteria included in Appendix 2.

Symptomatic heart failure (per New York Heart Association guidelines; (Caraballo, 2019), unstable angina, myocardial infarction, severe cardiovascular disease (ejection fraction \< 20%, transient ischemic attack, or cerebrovascular accident within 6 months of Day 1).
corrected QT based on Fridericia's formula (QTcF) \> 450 msec (for men) or \> 470 msec (for women).
